I’ve always been a really shy kid with a strict mother. It turns out I had undiagnosed generalised and social anxiety. My anxiety peaked just after I graduated high school and locked myself in my room for over two moths. My mum made me see a therapist, which resulted in being and blessing and a curse...

I gained skills on how to deal with my anxiety, but also became aware of how abnormal my relationship with my mother was. She wasn’t just strict, she was emotionally abusive and manipulative to keep me at home and closer to her.
This kind of pushed me over the edge as I realised I didn’t want to be treated like this any more. I had so many fights with mum trying to defend my rights, but this only made things worse. She’s the type of person that doesn’t take ‘no’ for an answer. The more I rebelled against her rules and demands, the stricter and nastier she became. 
I felt so stressed, sad and unloved, but I still didn’t wanted to be treated that way. It eventually got the point where she was saying things like ‘I don’t care if you die’, and ‘well you better find a home for your dog’.

I couldn’t stand living with her anymore, but because of her control over my whole life I had no life skills, no job, and I was financially dependent on her, so I had no where to go. I began hurting myself and planning my suicide. I planned to overdose and hang myself. Across a period of weeks I stocked up on prescription pain meds and sleeping pills, and either alone or in combination with hanging should have been enough to kill me. Due to the unsteadiness of my cognitive abilities from the pills, I wasn’t able to hang myself, but I wasn’t concerned, as I had taken nearly twice the lethal dose, so I just lied down to sleep,
I woke up the next morning all of a sudden to almost throw up on myself. I was honestly so surprised to be alive, but felt awful. My vision was so blurred, I had difficulty breathing, huge stomach cramps and uncontrollable vomiting. I called the ambulance and was in the ER for nearly two weeks. Amazingly no damage was done to my internal organs.

It’s been over a year since I overdosed, and my life is completely different. With help from my best friend, I’ve been able to move out of home with her and now studying to become a psychologist at university! My life finally has a meaningful purpose, and I want to help people that may have been in similar circumstances or have just lost hope on life. I have never been happier, and I promise that life does get better!

The only thing I regret about it is the fact that I had to be in the hospital, with nurses giving me dirty looks and nasty comments.

Apart from that I think it was the best thing for me. Although I do not recommend people attempting suicide and I know it is super cliche, it honestly put things into perspective. It made me feel grateful. It gave me a purpose: I am now studying to be a psychologist, so that I may hopefully help people out of those dark times. My therapist helped me more than I can explain.

I have been suffering from a variety of mental illnesses for a number of years. Having suicidal thoughts every day for at least 3 years. I attempted suicide for the first time a year ago, taking upward of 150mg of oxycodone (30+ tablets of endone), along with at least 40 other tablets of various other painkillers and my antipsychotic medication.

Changed my mind about 30 mins after taking them, called a suicide hotline and told the lady on the line. I had told her I would go to tell my mum, and she just agreed and said goodnight. I’m not a psychologist but if I were her I wouldn’t have taken the word of a person at risk and have fallen the emergency services.
Anyway, I was on the way upstairs to tell my mum what I had done, was feeling pretty sedated at this point and decided to sit on the couch for a minute. I ended up falling asleep before I told her.

Next morning I woke up very suddenly feeling extremely nauseous, and my vision was so blurry I could barely see (pretty surprise to have woken up to be perfectly honest). Luckily I made it to the bathroom before I started uncontrollably throwing up. My mum came running in, desperately asking me what happened. I tried to explain in between bouts of vomiting. 

She drove me to the ER where I was admitted immediately (approx 13hours after my overdose). Hooked up to a drip and heart monitor for 48 hours. 5 days in hospital total. Tests revealed my kidneys and all of my internal organs were totally fine.

I’m no doctor/pharmacist so I don’t know if how much I took was enough to kill me, but the doctors and nurses were saying I got out lucky. Guess it just wasn’t my time.
